note: Committed government + major-industry funding and jobs pipelines, 5–10yr forward. The demand engine behind future migration and capital growth. STATUS matters — projects get delayed/cancelled (e.g. Whyalla H2), so each carries a status. Curated from government/industry sources; refresh at budget times (May federal, ~June states) or when a project's status changes. Sersi flags when this file is >90 days old.
